scope: Retained primary pages, proactive Moments preparation and interaction-first scheduling; existing UI and business flow preserved
performanceAcceptance: Physical-device Release latency, frame-time and memory acceptance remain unmeasured; no universal instant-open guarantee is asserted
rootCausesAddressed: Optional decoded-art readiness was blocking otherwise authorized cached page entry
Ordinary Home press guards synchronously read Reanimated UI-thread shared values
Already laid-out retained pages waited an unnecessary animation frame before transition start
Hidden primary pages were not preparing changed domain models until focus
Moments history ownership lived in the mounted/focused screen rather than global activity synchronization
Preload, reconciliation and whole-snapshot serialization could compete with active touches and transitions
Decorate used a fixed two-frame return delay; Plushie Switch waited for network confirmation instead of the existing durable edit queue

changes.primaryPages: Home, Burrow, Quests, Shop, Moments and Collection warm serially while idle and retain keyed views/layout. Relevant hidden models update during idle; unrelated updates do not invalidate them. Identity/access revocation remains immediate.
changes.moments: Global authorized in-memory cache prepares at bootstrap/activity-version change and foreground recovery. Focus only acknowledges the reminder. Reads are single-flight/coalesced; stale responses are fenced; offline data is retained with bounded retry backoff. Pagination and manual refresh remain supported; unchanged rows retain identity.
changes.entry: Ready authorized business models navigate directly; optional image decode is deferred. Missing bootstrap, pair authorization, game ownership/session/history and Release status still use bounded preparation and Retry/Cancel.
changes.scheduling: Touch/action/transition priority postpones speculative work and full snapshot serialization. Critical durable command and wallet writes remain synchronous. Interrupted touch/transition leases recover; background transition clears priority.
changes.homeTapGuard: JS press guard uses a generation-fenced mirror; native gesture cancellation and late-callback protection remain intact without synchronous UI-thread reads on ordinary presses.
changes.returnHandoff: Decorate waits for actual retained Home design commit when available, with bounded fallback. Existing local durable purchase/edit intents, server authority, idempotency, rollback and offline retry remain in place. Owned Plushie Switch uses the same durable local edit queue.
changes.diagnostics: Bounded 64-sample local phase timings, without user content, parameters or telemetry. JS touch-event receipt is explicitly not physical touch latency.

coverage: Cache-first entry, optional-art failure and cold-entry cancellation/retry
Authorized proactive Moments loading, single-flight/version bursts, pagination, offline recovery and unchanged card identity
Account/pair replacement, revoked access and stale-response fencing
Actual hidden useBurrow subscription preparation and synchronous revocation
Touch/transition priority, idle cancellation/serialization and interrupted-state recovery
Retained navigation/history, edge gesture policy and Home pull delayed-press guards
Durable room edits, Home commit handoff, duplicate Switch protection and failed-storage retry
Existing wallet, pricing, permissions, receipts, pairing, purchases, offline queues and database regression suites

iosNative.environment: iOS 26.2 Pro Max simulator, isolated com.novame.localsecureqa application, real retained navigator/page components and local art; fixture API/store/storage boundaries
passedObservations: Home, Burrow, Quests, Shop and Moments visibly render using real page components
Home completion event: history-read count is 2 before Moments entry and stays 2 after entry; new row is already visible
Shop completion event: history-read count is 2 before Moments entry and stays 2 after entry; new row is already visible
Moments Back and Shop Go back return successfully without a second entrance
Shop Windows category and visible item position survive exit and re-entry
Backgrounding through the simulator Home button and reopening retains the Shop Windows state and usable content

illustrativeTimingsOnly.basis: Local JS handler-to-commit phase samples from the isolated simulator, not physical release-to-paint or Release P95

limitations: Coordinate drag attempts did not produce an effective native edge gesture; edge/Home-pull policies and races pass automated regression tests but this run is not a successful native drag acceptance
QA router detail pushes and business writes are stubbed; native payment/product-detail/server end-to-end acceptance is not claimed
No physical-device Release P50/P95/P99, frame-time, repeated-cycle memory or thermal profiling was performed
